# cycle_images (Data Source)

Lists Cycle images in the hub, optionally filtered to those built from a specific image source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every image in the hub.
data "cycle_images" "all" {}

# List only images built from a specific image source.
data "cycle_images" "from_source" {
  source_id = cycle_image_source.docker_hub.id
}

output "image_ids" {
  value = [for image in data.cycle_images.from_source.images : image.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `source_id` (String) When set, only images created from this image source ID are returned.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) The list of images. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the image.
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the image.
- `size` (Number) The size of the image in bytes.
- `state` (String) The current state of the image.
